name: search-people
description: Searches Apollo's database of people for sales leads (prospects) by job title, company domain, location, seniority or keywords: the people at a company, or the heads of sales in a city. Spends no Apollo credits. Answers each person's Apollo id, first name, obfuscated last name, title and company, and whether Apollo holds an email; never a full last name, an email address or a phone number, which Apollo reveals only through its paid enrichment, which this tool does not call. A lead found here is not saved to the team, and its obfuscated last name is not one apollo__save-contact can save.

organizationDomains.description: Company domains to match, such as apollo.io.

perPage.description: Number of people per page, up to 25.
